_about: Company identities and profiles. `name` must match companies.name exactly. `domain` is used to show the company's logo; `featured` marks a recognised employer that lists and the map put first; `industry` and `description` say in one line what the company makes. All of it was written from general knowledge by an LLM and has not been checked one by one: a wrong domain shows the wrong logo, and a description may be out of date. Regenerate the SQL with: node scripts/build-company-profiles-sql.mjs data/companies/profiles.json migrations/0013_company_profiles.sql and node scripts/build-company-descriptions-sql.mjs data/companies/profiles.json migrations/0019_company_descriptions.sql
